<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1291
Claimant:
Jeff Taylor
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
01/06/2025
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision in which the insured vehicle was struck by another
vehicle. The claimant reports neck pain and has retained counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's office.
01/30/2025
Police report obtained. The reporting officer confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene and that the
vehicles came to rest in the positions described.
02/07/2025
Photographs of the damage received from the insured. The front-end damage on the vehicle is consistent with the
reported impact and the reported speed.
02/11/2025
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was active on the loss date. Nothing in the file points to
damage existing before the policy period began.
02/21/2025
Vehicle history checked. No prior damage claims or repair records are on file for this vehicle.
02/23/2025
Attorney letter received with medical authorization. Claimant's initial treatment began within a day of the collision and
followed a typical course of evaluation, imaging, and physical therapy.
04/15/2025
Prior records requested. The claimant had a minor strain in the same area of the neck several years ago, which
resolved fully with treatment. The reported injury pattern fits the force of this collision.
05/07/2025
Recorded statement from the claimant obtained through counsel. The claimant added a few small details about the
momnets after impact, but the core acocunt matches the original report.
05/19/2025
No independent witnesses have come forward. The photographs confirm several details of the scene but do not show
the collision itself.
06/19/2025
Treatment notes reviewed. Therapy visits tapered off as the claimant's symptoms improved, and the treating
provider's notes describe steady recovery.
07/31/2025
File reviewed for handling. Liability and injury evaluation are proceeding on the current documentation, with a
settlement discussion to follow once the final treatment summary is received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
